$comment: Structural half of the long-form-sitting guidance: the machine-checkable page mix for a deck planned from a named sitting. Density (pages per minute), per-page narration budgets and the teaching-function modules are prose, not structure — they cannot be checked here and ride in via the plan, the per-page briefs and materialFacts. Rendered and checked like every other skill's constraints (lib/server/agent-runtime/skills.ts); violations come back to the agent as a tool-result diagnostic so it can re-plan.
